IMG ALIGN

bottom (default) text bottom middle top text after.

left: text runs beside the picture and goes on past its bottom to show it wrapping under the float once the picture ends, as the specification describes it.
right: the same on the other side, with enough words to run past the bottom of the picture and wrap under it.
